caption: The drawing features three main grayscale renderings of the same object: a decorative object shaped like a horseshoe with additional symbolic elements. At the top of the horseshoe sits a sculpted eagle with wings spread wide. The horseshoe has the appearance of metal and includes bolt holes as seen on traditional horseshoes. Within the open center of the horseshoe, there are two horizontal bars. The upper bar contains the text "GOOD" and the lower bar contains the text "LUCK". Between the bars, in the center, there is an image of two hands clasping in a handshake. The object is shown from three perspectives: a frontal view at the upper left, a side profile to the right of the frontal view, and an angled three-dimensional view at the bottom right. A small scale is included beneath the frontal view, marked in inches up to 2 inches. The background is plain and off-white, with a small mark in the upper right quarter and the inscription "Mildred Ford" in the lower left corner.
title: Flat Iron Holder
